## About FANUC

FANUC started the development of NCs in 1955, and ever since, has devoted itself to focusing on
factory automation.
FANUC is active in the fields of FA, which encompasses basic technologies, consisting of NCs
(numerical controls), servos and lasers, and Robots to which such basic technologies are applied, as
well as Robomachines.
Through the diligent efforts of FANUC to apply IoT/AI technologies to all fields, consisting of FA,
Robots and Robomachines, customers are able to use FANUC products more efficiently.
FANUC also offers service, with a policy for not terminating support of FANUC products as long as
they are used by customers.
Through such activities, FANUC contributes to the development of manufacturing industries in Japan
and overseas, by promoting automation and efficiency in customers' factories.

**WHO WE ARE**

### A Global Leader in Warehouse Automation.

We design, build, integrate, and support intelligent systems that boost efficiency and productivity
across distribution centers. Our software-first approach combines modular architecture, cloud
migration, and pre-built value to deliver seamless, future-ready operations.

**WHAT WE DO**

### End-to-End Automation, Delivered.

Intelligrated delivers end-to-end design, installation, integration, and lifecycle support for
warehouse automation systems. Our solutions integrate cloud-native and hybrid WES software,
robotics, simulation tools, and more, providing optimized performance without disrupting your
workflows.

* Seamless future planning powered by AI-driven BI softwares

## Solutions For Your Operations

#### AMR Solutions

The AMR autonomous forklift project is expected to enhance material handling efficiency by 15%,
reduce labor costs by 30%, improve workplace safety, and enable sustainable production.

The project helps customers connect the final 1 cm of flexible production integration, enabling
logistics handling and automated conveying between raw materials. It achieves autonomous cross-floor
and cross-factory operations, further reducing manual intervention and improving production
efficiency.

The project involves the implementation of 35 narrow aisle stacker forklifts, featuring
high-precision positioning of ±2mm and 360° safety protection.

In pharmaceutical packaging production lines and logistics transfer warehouses, the project helps
the company automate inbound and outbound operations, receiving high recognition from the client.

the implementation.

## Beacon Robot**Who we are?**

Suzhou Beacon Robot Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2018 and located at Yuanhe High-Tech
Intelligent Manufacturing Park, is a company dedicated to the research and development, design,
assembly, sales, implementation, and after-sales services of a full range of intelligent mobile
handling robots (AMR/AGV). The company primarily provides unmanned industrial intelligent
warehousing and material handling system solutions for its users.

## Benefits of an Automated Industrial Parts Washer

An industrial parts washer is a heavy-duty, automated cleaning system that removes contaminants —
such as oils, coolants, metal chips, and carbon buildup — from manufactured components, engines, and
equipment. Using a combination of heat, pressure, and cleaning detergents, these systems replace
slow, manual scrubbing with fast, repeatable cleaning that meets stringent cleanliness standards.
* ### Reduced Downtime
  
  Facilities report up to 50% faster turnaround compared to manual washing
* ### Consistent Quality
  
  Controlled wash, rinse, and dry cycles clean every part to the same standard – no operator
  fatigue, no variability
* ### Lower operating costs
  
  Filtration and water recycling cut consumable use by up to 30%
* ### Sustainability gains
  
  Water reuse and biodegradable detergents reduce waste and environmental impact
* ### Operator safety
  
  Enclosed, automated systems limit operator contact with solvents, hot fluids, and contaminants

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

manufacturing automation, including the design and manufacturing of industrial robot arms, since the
1960s. DENSO is also the world’s largest user of small assembly robots, from 4-axis SCARA robots to
5- and 6-axis [articulated robots.][58]

DCS’s design and engineering team has more than 40 years of experience creating unique parcel
handling systems for diverse customer applications. With installations including semi-automated
handling in small city distribution centers and fully automated, integrated hubs with advanced
conveyor and sorter equipment, DCS routinely thinks outside the box.

[E-Commerce and Multi-Channel Fulfillment][40]
DCS designs and implements end-to-end warehouse automation solutions for e-commerce and
multi-channel retailers that address numerous workflow challenges. This includes solutions for
receiving, putaway, storage, replenishment, order fulfillment, picking, packing, sortation, and
outbound shipping. Our custom integrated warehouse, distribution, and fulfillment systems draw from
a deep pool of conventional, semi-automated, and automated material handling technologies.

Whether an operation is considering the construction of a new distribution or fulfillment center, or
a retrofit or expansion of an existing facility, it’s important to create a solution that fits the
overarching supply chain strategy. DCS has four decades of experience designing and integrating
comprehensive, end-to-end material handling solutions that meet a multitude of operational goals.
Whether conventional, semi-automated, or fully automated, DCS can help your organization implement a
custom solution that meets its goals while maximizing return on investment (ROI).

improvement recommendations, or distribution design services, DCS consultants will help guide you to
the material handling system or operational solution that best meets your current and future needs,

productivity are the goals of DCS’ Customer Service Team. By partnering with DCS, your warehouse

system expert. Plus, DCS offers a complete package of spare parts and expert system troubleshooting
support from qualified engineers dedicated to your installation.

## A Legacy of Excellence

DMW&H is a premier Material Handling Integrator, backed by over 60 years of experience and
strengthened by enduring customer relationships. Our distinct advantage lies in our steadfast
commitment to collaboration. Rather than merely offering material handling solutions, we work
closely with our Customers to develop the most innovative and customized systems that meet their
specific needs and challenges. Our expertise lies in creating bespoke solutions that enhance the
flow and efficiency of materials within our Customers’ operations. With decades of experience and
profound industry knowledge, we design solutions that enhance efficiency, increase productivity, and
maximize the potential of your operations. By choosing DMW&H, you are not just opting for a material
handling integrator; you are selecting a partner dedicated to relationships, innovation, and
excellence.

round-the-clock client support to ensure seamless and scalable distribution.

### Innovation Driven

DMW&H continually reevaluates operational paradigms with the latest technologies to offer our
Customers solutions that provide a competitive edge.

### Customized Solutions For Your Distribution Center

At DMW&H, we recognize that every facility is unique. We specialize in developing tailored solutions
that address your specific challenges and position you for future growth.

[ Become an Exhibitor arrow_forward ][19]
[ Why Attend arrow_forward ][20]


## The East Coast’s Future-Focused Manufacturing Connector

The Manufacturing Technology Series EAST features EASTEC in West Springfield, Massachusetts. The
event will take place in a region considered an epicenter of traditional manufacturing.
Historically, more than 500 companies have connected at this event to network, learn from industry
experts and explore the latest manufacturing technologies. 

More than 10% of the regional gross domestic product is derived from manufacturing, stemming from
2.5 million manufacturing jobs and $418.2 billion in total manufacturing output from more than
62,000 manufacturing companies. 

This three-day event provides manufacturing professionals with the ideal opportunity to make and
renew connections, explore the latest in manufacturing technology, and shape the future of business.
The Manufacturing Technology Series EAST event has been providing solutions to manufacturing
challenges for more than 35 years. Attendees work in a variety of industries, including aerospace,
automotive, medical, defense, industrial, commercial machinery, and more.


# Four Strategic Events.
# One Transformative Experience.

The Manufacturing Technology Series unites the best of four long-standing regional manufacturing
events — EAST, WEST, SOUTHEAST and SOUTHWEST — under one umbrella to ensure an unparalleled
experience for both attendees and exhibitors.

The Manufacturing Technology Series connects decision-makers from diverse industries with leading
suppliers of advanced manufacturing technology, equipment and tooling. By creating opportunities for
connection — between makers and users, thinkers and doers, and sellers and buyers — our events have
a role in advancing manufacturing.

## Review the 2025 Event Profile Brochure

Get ready to attend this premier regional event in the Northeast, designed to connect manufacturers,
innovators, and industry leaders across the country.

The Manufacturing Technology Series East brochure is your all-access guide to the technologies,
insights, and opportunities waiting for you in **West** **Springfield, MA**, this May. Dive into the
details—download the brochure and start planning your 3 day adventure at the event!

## The East Coast’s Future-Focused Manufacturing Connector

The Manufacturing Technology Series EAST features EASTEC in West Springfield, Massachusetts. The
event will take place in a region considered an epicenter of traditional manufacturing.
Historically, more than 500 companies have connected at this event to network, learn from industry
experts and explore the latest manufacturing technologies. 

More than 10% of the regional gross domestic product is derived from manufacturing, stemming from
2.5 million manufacturing jobs and $418.2 billion in total manufacturing output from more than
62,000 manufacturing companies. 

This three-day event provides manufacturing professionals with the ideal opportunity to make and
renew connections, explore the latest in manufacturing technology, and shape the future of business.
The Manufacturing Technology Series EAST event has been providing solutions to manufacturing
challenges for more than 35 years. Attendees work in a variety of industries, including aerospace,
automotive, medical, defense, industrial, commercial machinery, and more.


# Four Strategic Events.
# One Transformative Experience.

The Manufacturing Technology Series unites the best of four long-standing regional manufacturing
events — EAST, WEST, SOUTHEAST and SOUTHWEST — under one umbrella to ensure an unparalleled
experience for both attendees and exhibitors.

The Manufacturing Technology Series connects decision-makers from diverse industries with leading
suppliers of advanced manufacturing technology, equipment and tooling. By creating opportunities for
connection — between makers and users, thinkers and doers, and sellers and buyers — our events have
a role in advancing manufacturing.

## Review the 2025 Event Profile Brochure

Get ready to attend this premier regional event in the Northeast, designed to connect manufacturers,
innovators, and industry leaders across the country.

The Manufacturing Technology Series East brochure is your all-access guide to the technologies,
insights, and opportunities waiting for you in **West** **Springfield, MA**, this May. Dive into the
details—download the brochure and start planning your 3 day adventure at the event!

## About Us

**EXCELLENCE ROBOTICS AUTOMATION PVT LTD (ERAA PVT LTD)** is a Pune, India based company, leading in
robotics and automation world, catering to various industries like Automotive, Non Automotive
General Industries **EXCELLENCE ROBOTICS AUTOMATION PVT LTD (ERAA PVT LTD)** has world wide customer
base

**EXCELLENCE ROBOTICS AUTOMATION PVT LTD (ERAA PVT LTD)** is Turnkey Solution provider for all kind
of Industrial Robotics and Automation

We have several years of experience and research to derive the successful solutions catering to
every market need

**EXCELLENCE ROBOTICS AUTOMATION PVT LTD (ERAA PVT LTD)** is one stop shop for all kind of
Industrial robotic solutions for Line Automation, Simulation, Robot services, Robotic work Cell
Lines for Spot welding, MIG welding, Material handling, Sealing, Painting, Assembly, Inspection,
Hemming and many more

## Our Services

##### Robotic Service

We offer a comprehensive range of robotic services for both offline and online programming. With
offline programming, we provide complete line simulation and process development, including
simulation inputs, data deliverables, process optimization, and tool selection for various
applications such as spot welding, material handling, laser cutting, and more. On the other hand,
our online programming expertise involves hands-on robot setup, tool calibration, application
configuration, and process validation, ensuring quality improvement, cycle time optimization, and
production support. Whether offline or online, our services cover a wide array of applications,
including welding, assembly, inspection, painting, and more.

##### PLC Service

Our expertise extends from small-scale to large-scale systems, ranging from a few I/Os to several
thousand I/Os. Our solutions include hot standby redundant PLC and SCADA systems, wireless
communication, data logging, detailed reporting, and graphical representation of data. With careful
selection of products such as PLC, SCADA, HMI, VFD, and Servo, we design tailored solutions that
deliver optimal performance, saving time and costs. We excel in utilizing PLCs for digital and
analog input handling, implementing communication protocols like Hardwiring, Device Net, Profi bus,
and Ethernet, enabling seamless interaction between shop floor and top floor for monitoring and
control.

##### Control Service

Our control services encompass a comprehensive range of offerings. This includes panel design,
manufacturing, and assembly, as well as on-field wiring and piping for seamless integration.
Additionally, our design services cover process study, layout design, concept design, manufacturing
design, CAD model design, detailing and drafting, feasibility study, ergonomics, and reverse
engineering. With our expertise, we ensure efficient control system implementation, precise panel
manufacturing, and meticulous design processes that adhere to industry standards, resulting in
optimized functionality and streamlined operations.

##### Mechanical Service

Our mechanical services encompass a wide range of expertise. We specialize in mechanical design,
utilizing advanced software to create innovative and efficient solutions. Our manufacturing
capabilities ensure precise fabrication and assembly of mechanical components. We provide
comprehensive layout design services, optimizing space utilization and workflow efficiency.
Additionally, our process study enables us to analyze and optimize mechanical processes, identifying
areas for improvement. With our integrated mechanical services, we deliver high-quality designs,
streamlined manufacturing processes, and optimized layouts for enhanced productivity and operational
effectiveness.

## [Delta Cobots Win BIG SEE Product Design Award 2026][3]

**[Delta][4]** - Delta has been honored with the BIG SEE Product Design Award 2026 for the Delta
D-Bot series of collaborative robots. The internationally recognized BIG SEE Awards recognize
outstanding creative achievements in the fields of architecture, product design, and industrial
design. Originally established to promote Southeast Europe (SEE), the award has evolved into a
global platform that celebrates innovation and sustainability.

## [Emerson’s Next-Generation Portable Ultrasonic Flow Meters Offer Greater Flexibility for
## Plant-Wide Transparency][5]

**[Emerson][6]** - Today Emerson released the new Flexim FLUXUS 631 series of portable non-intrusive
clamp-on ultrasonic flow meters. The 631 series delivers flexible, precise and reliable measurement
of liquids, gases and steam in a single platform across a wide range of demanding industrial and
municipal applications without interrupting operations. This enables users to increase maintenance
and energy efficiency and improve plant performance.

## [How a bold engineering idea changed an entire industry and became central to the AI data center
## boom][7]

**[Danfoss][8]** - A new book “The Cool Purpose: The Journey of Danfoss Turbocor in Engineering a
Better Future” chronicles the rich history of the Danfoss Turbocor compressor, the world's first
oil-free magnetic bearing compressor. Turbocor was founded in the mid-1990s in Australia by a group
of engineers with a belief that oil-free and magnetic-bearing compressor technology had the
potential to transform the HVAC industry and lead the way toward more sustainable cooling solutions.

## [3M joins Cadillac Formula 1 Team as Official Material Science Partner to accelerate racing
## performance][9]

**[3M][10]** - The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and 3M today announced a multi-year global partnership to
push the limits of innovation in the world's toughest laboratory, Formula 1. As the team's Official
Material Science Partner, 3M scientists and engineers will work closely with the Cadillac Formula 1
Team to support car development, advance performance and streamline operations.

## [3M and Airbus announce agreement to advance A220 passenger comfort and aircraft performance
## through advanced insulation technology][11]

**[3M][12]** - 3M and Airbus, a leading aircraft manufacturer, have signed a long-term supply
agreement to help drive the continued advancement of passenger comfort and aircraft performance on
the Airbus A220. The agreement underscores both companies' commitment to innovation in aircraft
design and passenger experience.

## [Emerson Adds Combustible Gas Detection to Core Wireless Sensor for Enhanced Safety Coverage in
## Hard-to-Reach Areas][13]

**[Emerson][14]** - Emerson has expanded the capabilities of its Rosemount 928 Wireless Gas Monitor
by adding combustible gas detection, enabling percent lower explosive limit (%LEL) monitoring over
the secure WirelessHART platform. The update helps users monitor combustible hazards in remote or
hard‑to‑wire locations without the need for additional power or costly signal wiring.

## [Lifetime Achievement for pioneer in power-conversion technology behind electric grids][15]

**[European Patent Office][16]** - For his outstanding career in power electronics and grid
infrastructure, the European Patent Office (EPO) has announced that Rainer Marquardt is the
recipient of the Lifetime Achievement distinction for the European Inventor Award 2026. The EPO will
honour his work during the ceremony livestreamed from Berlin on 2 July 2026, at which the winners of
the Industry, Non-EPO Countries, Research and SMEs categories will also be announced.

## [€23 million Data Space Accelerator launched to fast-track SME integration within the Catena-X

1. ### Design & Engineer
   
   Layout, simulation, and machine design tailored to your product, throughput, and footprint.

3. ### Install & Commission
   
   Streamlined installation anywhere in North America, with startup times shortened by pre-shipment
   run-off.
4. ### Support & Maintain
   
   Remote support, parts, and service that keep your line running long after commissioning.

## Answers for plant managers and engineers

What does J+H Automation Solutions do?

We're a full-service industrial automation engineering and systems integration company. We design,
build, install, and maintain custom machinery, conveyor and material handling systems, robotics and
AGVs, control systems, and machine vision systems for manufacturing operations of all sizes.

What areas do you serve?

We serve manufacturers across all of North America — the United States, Canada, and Mexico — from
our facility in Hackett, Arkansas, near Fort Smith. Systems are fully built and proven in the USA
before shipping anywhere.

Do you build and test systems before installation?

Yes. Every system is assembled, integrated, and run off in our facility, and you're invited to
review and approve the working system before it ships. That means shorter on-site startups, fewer
surprises, and lower installation risk.

## Robot Integration

Robotics integration uses robotic systems in strategic areas to perform automated tasks. Robotics
system integrators like JS Controls analyze your manufacturing, material handling, or inspection
lines; determine which areas could be improved; and install the automation technology in those
areas. There are typically two main applications for robotics integration — industrial robotics and
collaborative robotics.

Industrial robotic systems are machines designed to complete repetitive actions in industrial
settings. These robots can be multi-axis robotic arms, automated guided vehicles, automated cells,
or conveyance. Modern advancements have made these systems flexible and scalable....

# Custom Robotic Integrator

Leaders in robotic automation since 1990.

[ Talk to a certified integrator ][39]

## Turn high stakes into high performance.

The stakes are too high to partner with anything less than an experienced team of robotic
integrators. We work with you to increase productivity and deliver the ROI you need. That’s what we
do for our clients.

We understand how daunting automation can be. As engineers ourselves, precision is the only
acceptable path. That’s why we meticulously prove out a robotic solution that targets your core
problems. Clients from NASA to Toyota trust us to deliver precise, flexible solutions that deliver
on efficiency, ROI, timing, and budget.

[ Talk to a certified integrator ][40]
^{Core capabilities}
* Welding
* Assembly
* Cutting, grinding, & finishing
* Material handling & tending
* CNC machine tending
* Injection mold machine tending
* Pre-engineered solutions
* ### Welding
  
  KC Robotics is an industry leader for integrating automated welding systems. Our process expertise
  in Robotic Arc Welding, Laser welding, and Additive Manufacturing will help you decrease
  manufacturing costs, improve productivity, and increase weld quality.
  
  [ Learn more ][41]
* ### Assembly
  
  KC Robotics will show you the benefits of automation for your assembly process. We partner with
  your team to design, engineer and build a solution that enhances your production line and improves
  the quality and consistency of the assembled product.
  
  [ Learn more ][42]
* ### Cutting, grinding, & finishing
  
  KC Robotics is an industry leader in Robotic cutting trimming and finishing systems. Our years of
  experience utilizing high speed routers, ultrasonic knives and lasers give us a depth of knowledge
  to design and implement a robotic system that will improve productivity, quality, reliability and
  safety in your manufacturing processes.
  
  [ Learn more ][43]
* ### Material handling & tending
  
  KC Robotics designs and builds robotic material handling systems that fit your specific needs.
  From simple pick and place solutions to CNC Machine Tending or customized part handling lines, KC
  Robotics will implement a robotic system to improve productivity, quality and reliability in your
  manufacturing processes.
  
  [ Learn more ][44]
* ### CNC machine tending
  
  Finding qualified skilled labor for your CNC Machining operation is more difficult than ever. KC
  Robotics offers complete robotic CNC loading and tending systems. Our straight-forward plan will
  help your company get on the right track to success.
  
  [ Learn more ][45]
* ### Injection mold machine tending
  
  Automated injection molding solves multiple manufacturing concerns – safety, operation costs and
  quality. KC Robotics offers robotic injection mold tending systems for progressive consumer goods
  manufacturers.
  
  [ Learn more ][46]
* ### Pre-engineered solutions
  
  Pre-Engineered and Standard Robotic Solutions from KC Robotics provide a high quality system with
  lower equipment costs and a faster implementation time through standardization. KC Robotics offers
  several systems for Arc Welding, Cutting and CNC Machine Tending.
  
  [ Learn more ][47]
^{Why choose KC Robotics?}

Beginning with the sales process, our focus is on design concepts. We prove out our designs during
engineering approval and work with your team through engineering, programming and installation to
ensure that your robotic system provides the solution you need.

### Expertise

Kinemetrix builds solid robotic automation systems for challenging applications. We help our
customers compete and win in fast-changing, uncertain markets. Our [Agile Automation][34] approach
ensures flexibility and minimizes risk at every phase of the project.

When you have a project that seems impossible to automate, [contact us][35]. Our application
engineers bring you decades of experience and an expansive toolkit to solve your problems.

Maybe you’re a new-domestic automotive manufacturer, frustrated working with North American machine
builders. You’re in the right place. Because Kinemetrix has deep roots serving lean organizations.
We understand you.

integrator allows us to offer and support the latest robotic technologies: 3D robot vision guidance,
conveyor tracking, force feedback, AgileArm™ servo End-of-Arm Tooling, servo-coordinated robotic
dispensing, etc. We maintain an active R&D lab to create new technology, hone our skills, and test
new applications in a safe environment.

Our headquarters is convenient to manufacturers along the I-75 corridor: Kentucky, Tennessee,
Indiana, Ohio, Illinois, Michigan. And Kinemetrix systems operate successfully across the US,

## Company **Overview**

Master Automation & Robotics stands for engineering, innovation and quality. The company has been a
pioneer in the field of automated material handling and conveying solutions since 1984. The company
has a rich history of more than 35 years and legacy of 1000+ project installations.

The customer base includes some of the leading Indian and multinational companies. The customer
approach is defined by five key elements: Affordable | Flexible | Modular | Innovative | Accessible.

The excellent infrastructure and qualified team enables the company to deliver the projects in time
while meeting all the customer requirements and expectations. We nurture our association with our
customers into a long-standing business relationship.

## Engineered for What’s Next

MWES designs and builds fully customized automation systems from robotic welding and palletizing to
machine tending, vision inspection, and complete line integration. Every solution is engineered
in-house, including mechanical and electrical design, software development, fabrication, and Factory
Acceptance Testing. That means tighter control, faster delivery, and a solution built precisely for
your process, not a one-size-fits-all system. Whether you’re upgrading a single station or launching
a new production line, we deliver automation that works the way you need it to.

###### Technology Spotlight

MC1 and MZ1 Series of 44-turn rotary sensors measure turns and angles to 15,840°. These two series
have different housing profiles and mounting. Both feature 16-bit resolution and independent
linearity of ±1°. Sealed to IP67. Both continue to track and save position and count during power
loss. [Learn more][70].

###### Featured Position Sensor Applications
* 
  
  Commercial combine/mower: Accurately measuring position of mower arms as they are lowered, raised
  or locked in position. Click on photo to learn more.
  
  [ ][71]
* 
  
  Wakeboard Wave: Control of a horizontal surface that enables a watersports boat to create
  controllable wakes and waves that for wakeboarding. Click on photo to learn more.
  
  [ ][72]
* 
  
  NASCAR and F1 Race Cars: steering-angle pickup. Click on photo to learn more or see other
  applications.
  
  [ ][73]
* 
  
  Two linear displacement sensors are used for controlling and monitoring the dosing pump. Click on
  photo to learn more or see other applications.
  
  [ ][74]
* 
  
  A linear position sensor enables automated adjustment of the height of a robotic tool trolley used
  in automotive assembly and other manufacturing plants. Click on photo to learn more.
  
  [ ][75]
* 
  
  London Eye: sensing the loading ramp position. Click on photo to learn more or see other
  applications.
  
  [ ][76]

###### 
###### Choosing the right position sensor


See our [Applications page][77] to read about some of the applications Novotechnik linear position
sensors and angle sensors are used in. Our [Products page][78] has interactive selector guides to
help you choose the best sensor based on your criteria.

###### Product News

###### Heavy Duty Multi-Turn Sensors

MB1 Series of 44-turn non-contacting sensors have solid, semi-hollow or hollow-shaft versions.
Repeatability is less than ±0.1° with galvanized steel housing and stainless steel shaft and
coupling. [Read more][79].

# Products Built For Reliable Material Handling

Built for durability, stability, and safety, our pallet trucks, pallet stackers, and pallet
counterbalance forklifts deliver reliable performance for every
warehouse task-from pallet moving to heavy-duty lifting.
[Stable Electric Walkie Pallet Truck][89]
This electric pallet truck uses batteries as the power source, equipped with an AC drive system, and
implements electric walking and electric lifting. It is an ideal choice for your horizontal material
transportation. Its compact design can carry up to 2,000 kg, and its high ground clearance enables
it to seamlessly cross narrow aisles, providing you with the flexibility you need to easily and
efficiently transport materials.
[View More][90]
[Durable Electric Pallet Truck Lithium Power Pallet Jacks][91]
This lithium pallet truck is our best-selling and practical model, which can operate efficiently and
simplify the warehouse handling process, benefiting workers and enterprises.

*Rated Loading: 1500kg~2000kg
*Travel Speed: 5.2km/h
 
[View More][92]
[80V Lithium Battery Electric Counterbalance Forklift Truck][93]
The 80V lithium battery electric counterbalance forklift truck simplifies handling and completes the
work reliably and easily. With a lifting capacity of 3000~3500kg and a large motor of 13.6kw, it is
an energy-saving new lithium battery electric forklift that is perfect for any warehouse and paper
industry, supermarket or food industry.
[View More][94]
[1.5 Ton Electric Walkie Pallet Stacker][95]
NRT's electric Walkie pallet stacker is an adjustable and stackable solution for warehousing, a
versatile lift that can meet your various application needs.
[View More][96]
[1.3 Ton Electric Walkie Tow Tractor][97]
The NRT NT13Q01LD is a compact pedestrian electric tow tractor designed to pull carts and trolleys
weighing up to 1,300 kg. Its 520 mm narrow body, adjustable travel speed and small turning radius
make it suitable for factories, hospitals, hotels, airports and warehouse operations.

**Special features:**

*24V maintenance-free battery
*Parking brake system
*Replaceable lithium-ion battery
 
[View More][98]
[1.4-2 Ton Electric Moving Mast Reach Truck][99]
NRT's moving mast reach trucks have a maximum height of 2476mm, providing clear and precise control,
ensuring flexible and smooth operation. Coupled with a large-capacity lithium battery, operations
are more efficient.
[View More][100]
[Electric Forklift Truck With Lithium Power 3 Tons][101]
The electric forklift truck with lithium battery 3 ton has a load capacity range of 3000kg~3500kg,
and it can easily handle various working conditions, even if your business includes indoor and
outdoor operations.

**Special Functions:**

*3000-3500kg lifting capacity
*Ico lithium battery new energy
*Brand drive motor
[View More][102]
[OEM 2 Ton Lithium Battery Electric Pallet Jacks For Warehouse Handling Wholesale Price][103]
Lithium battery electric pallet jacks can efficiently and easily move products around the warehouse.
It has a long-lasting lithium battery and a compact body that can work in small spaces. With an 850w
motor and 200mm drive wheels, it can adapt to any application and handling occasion, making your
warehouse operations more relaxed and efficient.

structural performance with reduced installation time and long-term durability. With multiple panel
solutions, coatings, and surface options available, ResinDek provides engineered flooring solutions
that match specific load requirements, traffic patterns, equipment, and operational goals.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot

### Консалтинг, аудит и имитационное моделирование для складов

Проверяем решения на цифровых двойниках ещё до внедрения и анализируем текущие процессы для
разработки стратегии полной автоматизации. Моделируем десятки сценариев работы склада, оптимизируем
ресурсы, маршруты роботов и операции сотрудников, чтобы обеспечить бесперебойную работу даже при
пиковых нагрузках.

## Почему выбирают нас

### Гибкое масштабирование

Мы не просто запускаем роботов — мы создаём платформу для гибкой модернизации склада. С ростом
бизнеса вы сможете добавлять новых роботов и оборудование, что позволит снизить капитальные
и операционные расходы и повысить общую эффективность склада.

### Yandex Robotics Platform — платформа для беспрерывной роботизации

Yandex Robotics Platform — платформа для управления разным оборудованием от любых вендоров,
ускорения интеграции и вывода данных с устройств в удобные дашборды. Подходит как для новых
проектов, так и для уже работающей инфраструктуры.

### Отсутствие vendor lock

Позволяет подключать тех роботов, которые подходят лучше всего, без привязки к одному производителю.
Проект можно начать на оборудовании одного вендора и масштабировать с другими партнёрами, а YRP
остаётся универсальным инструментом для управления роботизацией.

### Технический консалтинг и имитационное моделирование

Предлагаем инструменты для создания цифровых двойников и имитационного моделирования склада ещё
до закупки роботов. Аудит помогает выявить узкие места, подобрать технологии и оценить
эффективность. Моделирование разных сценариев позволяет выбрать самое производительное и выгодное
решение.

### Открытость и гибкость

Наши открытые API и интеграционные возможности позволяют добавлять новые функции и оборудование.
Ваш склад всегда будет соответствовать вашим растущим потребностям, а гибкая система позволит
эффективно справляться с пиковыми нагрузками на складе.

### Поддержка

Наша команда всегда на связи и готова оказать любой уровень поддержки на своих проектах. Неважно,
поставляем мы собственное оборудование или роботов сторонних вендоров. Своевременное обслуживание
и оперативная помощь в случае инцидента — гарантия эффективности вашего бизнеса.

### Консалтинг, аудит и имитационное моделирование для складов

Проверяем решения на цифровых двойниках ещё до внедрения и анализируем текущие процессы для
разработки стратегии полной автоматизации. Моделируем десятки сценариев работы склада, оптимизируем
ресурсы, маршруты роботов и операции сотрудников, чтобы обеспечить бесперебойную работу даже при
пиковых нагрузках.

## Почему выбирают нас

### Гибкое масштабирование

Мы не просто запускаем роботов — мы создаём платформу для гибкой модернизации склада. С ростом
бизнеса вы сможете добавлять новых роботов и оборудование, что позволит снизить капитальные
и операционные расходы и повысить общую эффективность склада.

### Yandex Robotics Platform — платформа для беспрерывной роботизации

Yandex Robotics Platform — платформа для управления разным оборудованием от любых вендоров,
ускорения интеграции и вывода данных с устройств в удобные дашборды. Подходит как для новых
проектов, так и для уже работающей инфраструктуры.

### Отсутствие vendor lock

Позволяет подключать тех роботов, которые подходят лучше всего, без привязки к одному производителю.
Проект можно начать на оборудовании одного вендора и масштабировать с другими партнёрами, а YRP
остаётся универсальным инструментом для управления роботизацией.

### Технический консалтинг и имитационное моделирование

Предлагаем инструменты для создания цифровых двойников и имитационного моделирования склада ещё
до закупки роботов. Аудит помогает выявить узкие места, подобрать технологии и оценить
эффективность. Моделирование разных сценариев позволяет выбрать самое производительное и выгодное
решение.

### Открытость и гибкость

Наши открытые API и интеграционные возможности позволяют добавлять новые функции и оборудование.
Ваш склад всегда будет соответствовать вашим растущим потребностям, а гибкая система позволит
эффективно справляться с пиковыми нагрузками на складе.

### Поддержка

Наша команда всегда на связи и готова оказать любой уровень поддержки на своих проектах. Неважно,
поставляем мы собственное оборудование или роботов сторонних вендоров. Своевременное обслуживание
и оперативная помощь в случае инцидента — гарантия эффективности вашего бизнеса.

## Robotnik

Robotnik designs, manufactures and markets mobile robots and mobile manipulators.

Our company was founded in 2002 and **we are currently a reference company in mobile robotics
worldwide and leaders in Europe.**

[MORE INFORMATION][58]

### Our Services

Robotnik is specialized in the development of industrial robotic applications based in mobile
platforms and mobile manipulators.

## Pioneering automation

Rocla AGV Solutions are a full-service answer to your facility’s intralogistics challenges when you
want to ensure reliability, safety and efficiency. Purpose-fit [AGVs,][56] world-leading
[software][57] and [Life Cycle Services][58] are there to ensure that you reduce your material
handling costs and retain your assets’ value.

[Learn more ][59]

## Comprehensive logistic solutions

As a comprehensive solutions provider, we offer a wide range of material handling solutions and
services from [AGVs][60] and [manually operated forklifts][61] to [racking][62], [AGV system
software][63] and intralogistics consultation. Each solution is designed to optimally serve your
specific intralogistics processes. When choosing our complete solution, you can have it all from the
same provider while saving time and resources.

[Logisnext Solutions ][64]

## Recoup your investment in 1–2 years

Rocla AGV Solutions have a proven record of excellent return on investment. Our clients can recoup
their investments in as little as a year. Try our calculator and see how your company’s investment
could pay off.

[Calculate your ROI ][65]

## Request a simulation

Would you like to know how many AGVs your operations would require in order to automate your
processes and how they would navigate through your facility? Our experts can help determine these
details using our advanced simulation tool.  

Contact us at [[email protected]][66] and provide us with a DWG (warehouse drawing file) that
identifies the material flow, including pick-up locations, destinations and type of pick-up and
drop-off locations (e.g., floor, rack, conveyor). With this information, along with the load unit
specifications and the number of required movements per hour, our experts can provide a simulation
in no time with the possibility of a virtual meeting to discuss the results. 

[ Contact us ][67]

## Pioneering automation

Rocla AGV Solutions are a full-service answer to your facility’s intralogistics challenges when you
want to ensure reliability, safety and efficiency. Purpose-fit [AGVs,][56] world-leading
[software][57] and [Life Cycle Services][58] are there to ensure that you reduce your material
handling costs and retain your assets’ value.

[Learn more ][59]

## Comprehensive logistic solutions

As a comprehensive solutions provider, we offer a wide range of material handling solutions and
services from [AGVs][60] and [manually operated forklifts][61] to [racking][62], [AGV system
software][63] and intralogistics consultation. Each solution is designed to optimally serve your
specific intralogistics processes. When choosing our complete solution, you can have it all from the
same provider while saving time and resources.

[Logisnext Solutions ][64]

## Recoup your investment in 1–2 years

Rocla AGV Solutions have a proven record of excellent return on investment. Our clients can recoup
their investments in as little as a year. Try our calculator and see how your company’s investment
could pay off.

[Calculate your ROI ][65]

## Request a simulation

Would you like to know how many AGVs your operations would require in order to automate your
processes and how they would navigate through your facility? Our experts can help determine these
details using our advanced simulation tool.  

Contact us at [[email protected]][66] and provide us with a DWG (warehouse drawing file) that
identifies the material flow, including pick-up locations, destinations and type of pick-up and
drop-off locations (e.g., floor, rack, conveyor). With this information, along with the load unit
specifications and the number of required movements per hour, our experts can provide a simulation
in no time with the possibility of a virtual meeting to discuss the results.

# transform your workflow

As a full-system integrator, Stac specializes in designing, implementing, and installing innovative
material handling solutions tailored to the manufacturing, distribution, and e-commerce markets.
With over 20 years of experience, our passion towards integration excellence fosters a culture
committed to delivering automated and conventional material handling systems that are on time and
budget. Our expertise simplifies the customer experience while optimizing project outcomes
with [**conveyor systems**][136], [**industrial robotics**][137], and [**general material
handling**][138] solutions.

Stac is your trusted partner for seamless integration and advanced material handling solutions. Let
us simplify your next project.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Actionable Strategies

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions

increase your facility’s capacity through dense storage, maximize throughput with streamlined
operations, and create efficiency gains throughout your supply chain with AI-enhanced software that
sees beyond your warehouse walls.

## Solutions for Warehouse & Distribution

Distribution facilities automatically manage unlimited SKU volume from door-to-door while gaining

Goods are stored in their native cases within a fully secured system, on shelves with just enough
clear space for each case without the need for totes or trays.

## Solutions for
## Micro-Fulfillment

Each-pick and low unit of measure operations are optimized for fast order fulfillment through the
SymMicro System.

Goods are decanted into the SymMicro System, loose in totes, optimized for picking. Totes are
automatically retrieved from storage by SymBots and presented to an ergonomic pick station where an
operator fulfills multiple orders simultaneously.

SymMicro Systems are flexible and can be adapted for larger facilities or used in the back of retail
stores. They are tri-zone temperature capable, allowing ambient, refrigerated, and frozen goods to
be managed within a single solution.

## About Us

Tesca Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is World's Leading ISO Certified Manufacturer & Exporter of Test,
Measuring & Technical Education Equipment. We are Member for Electronics & Computer Software Export
Promotion Council, New Delhi, India having sales in more than 85+ Countries Worldwide.
Tesca's operations are spread out in 23000 Square Feet encompassing more then 2000 manufactured
Innovative Products and Turnkey Project Capabilities for International Tenders. Tesca is an Export
House established in December 2009 with our Registered & Corporate Office both set up at Jaipur.
We are actively doing business in Middle East, CIS, South East Asia, Africa as well as South America
Countries. We do have our representatives in almost all Countries. Please be noted that we are doing
projects meant for School Education, Vocational Training, Laboratory, Health Center, Hospital
Equipment, Agricultural Modernization, Industrial Modernization, Rural Water Supply as well as Small
Scale Enterprises funded by Ministry of Education, World Bank, Asian / African Development Bank as

## About Us

Tesca Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is World's Leading ISO Certified Manufacturer & Exporter of Test,
Measuring & Technical Education Equipment. We are Member for Electronics & Computer Software Export
Promotion Council, New Delhi, India having sales in more than 85+ Countries Worldwide.
Tesca's operations are spread out in 23000 Square Feet encompassing more then 2000 manufactured
Innovative Products and Turnkey Project Capabilities for International Tenders. Tesca is an Export
House established in December 2009 with our Registered & Corporate Office both set up at Jaipur.
We are actively doing business in Middle East, CIS, South East Asia, Africa as well as South America
Countries. We do have our representatives in almost all Countries. Please be noted that we are doing
projects meant for School Education, Vocational Training, Laboratory, Health Center, Hospital
Equipment, Agricultural Modernization, Industrial Modernization, Rural Water Supply as well as Small
Scale Enterprises funded by Ministry of Education, World Bank, Asian / African Development Bank as
well as GOI LOC. [Learn more about Tesca Global][36]

Finding the right parts for your equipment is easy when you have your model and serial number which
can be found on the data plate. Luckily, a forklift data plate is installed on every truck on the
market to help you understand what your forklift can do and provide vital information.

 

**Model Number: **The model number of your toyota forklift is extremely important for relaying
information to your dealers about repair or technical assistance and for looking up replacements
part!

 

**Serial Number: **The serial number on your lift is the most important number.The model serial
number combination will allow us to provide you with the parts that will fit your particular piece
of equipment.

**How to Find Your Equipment Model Number.**

 

Finding the right parts for your equipment is easy when you have your model and serial number which
can be found on the data plate. Luckily, a forklift data plate is installed on every truck on the
market to help you understand what your forklift can do and provide vital information.

 

**Model Number: **The model number of your toyota forklift is extremely important for relaying
information to your dealers about repair or technical assistance and for looking up replacements
part!

 

**Serial Number: **The serial number on your lift is the most important number.The model serial
number combination will allow us to provide you with the parts that will fit your particular piece
of equipment.

彤同台演出《牛起来》，这是目前人类顶级足式机器人技术与中国传统生肖文化的深度交融，也是全球首次四足机
器人动态走位集群舞蹈表演，引发了全民热议。
